stages.title: A shield before a screen.
stages.description: The historical review traces the dashboard to the protective board of a horse-drawn carriage, before it became a surface for driving information.

stages.title: The instrument panel.
stages.description: The research drawing groups speed, engine and fuel information with physical controls, establishing the familiar core of the dashboard.

stages.title: More signals. More to interpret.
stages.description: The historical survey follows the growth of warning symbols and indicators around the primary gauges.

stages.title: The electronic cluster.
stages.description: The review examines the move towards electronic instrument clusters and the increasing role of digital information.

stages.title: A framework for clarity.
stages.description: The historical review and preliminary research informed paper prototypes that separate navigation, critical driving information and vehicle status.
